title: Record the orthogonal core section histogram
body:
## Summary
- All 3780 orthogonal pairs have a common core of 24 roots and rank 7.
- Each core's 127 hyperplane sections have sizes `{0: 1, 8: 15, 12: 96, 16: 15}`.
- The aggregate is `{0: 3780, 8: 56700, 12: 362880, 16: 56700}`. No new kappa, and this histogram does not infer an invoice floor.
